violations.justification: The configuration sets drb_integrity to false, while its supplied mno_security_profile sets drb_integrity_required to true. P-01 states that data radio bearer integrity protection MUST be enabled when the applicable MNO security profile classifies integrity protection as required.

artifact.proposed_action: Submit a privileged change for authorized review to enable DRB integrity before continuing the requested service state.
findings: Configuration drb_integrity is false while the supplied MNO security profile states drb_integrity_required is true.
Retrieved policy P-01 requires data radio bearer integrity protection when the applicable MNO security profile requires it.
A bounded remediation candidate is to enable DRB integrity; this is proposed as a privileged action and not executed.
uncertainties: The retrieved policy is explicitly identified as an experimental operator policy and not an O-RAN or 3GPP specification.
No retrieved chunk establishes whether operator approval is required for this specific requested change.
No retrieved chunk establishes deployment status, runtime effect, or service impact of applying the patch.
